review_scope: Independent narrow review of the third-place X/Z handoff and immediate tray release; no hardware actions.
findings: Third physical ring determines the placement target. Lift target is the locked placement target minus 16000 virtual pulses, with existing bounds. Both X and Z queue then start from one CAN1 broadcast. The DM prepare path requires both X and Z real DONE flags and the current successful broadcast.
The same empty-handoff transaction retains its three-axis STOP/ACK, timeout, and reference checks. Confirmed software guards prevent posting DM on a stop or before real X/Z arrival.

On loaded tray arrival, phase 22 submits phase 26 release immediately when top and tray-index checks pass. The existing 100 ms dwell starts after successful PWM; subsequent DM commands, including final zero, remain after dwell.
The 2 mm and 1 degree alignment limits and both placement/recovery profile hashes are unchanged.
